title: Emergency Food Storage
description: How much food to store and what to start with: no-cook foods that need little water, then dry staples. Covers USDA and extension shelf-life data, containers, oxygen absorbers and Mylar bags, storage conditions, rotation, and infants, medical diets, and pets.
shortDescription: No-cook basics first, real shelf lives, oxygen absorbers, and rotation
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
